ROW.COLUMN: (ML/HH) Structuring: Deposits/Withdrawals of Mixed Monetary Instruments

This scenario generates an alert when the aggregate number and amount of deposits/withdrawal transactions (for cash and monetary instruments) are higher than specific predetermined thresholds, and the deposits/withdrawals are made into accounts associated with a Customer or Household during the Lookback Period.
See TSD for complete scenario description.
